title: Training Meals
overview: Ryoga challenges Ranma, but Ranma's battles with Cologne have made him far stronger. When Cologne appears before the vengeful Ryoga, what is her motive?

title: The Breaking Point
overview: Akane tags along for Ranma's training, while Ryoga works to master the deadly "The Breaking Point." How will their clash unfold when Akane gets involved?

title: Happosai Days Are Here Again
overview: The Tendo family hits the beach. As Happosai runs wild, Ranma tries to set him up with Cologne — but it seems they share a past tied to an heirloom.

title: The Way of Tea
overview: A man on a wild horse grabs Ranma. The culprit: Sentaro, heir of the Daimonji School of Martial Arts Tea Ceremony. A fierce succession battle begins!

title: The Way the Cookie Crumbles
overview: Akane and Kodachi battle over homemade cookies. As Ranma chases after Kodachi and the stolen treats, Gosunkugi secretly snaps a compromising photo.

title: I Ate the Whole Thing
overview: Ranma fights over a secretly taken photo with Kodachi, while Akane begins to suspect her scheme. Can Ranma get the photo negative and destroy the proof?

title: Quest for the Hidden Spring
overview: Ryoga tells Ranma he will soon part with P-chan after finding a map to the Japanese Spring of the Drowned Man — but it leads to the girls' locker room?

title: Tsubasa Kurenai Busts Loose!
overview: Ranma receives a challenge letter from the unknown Tsubasa Kurenai and is ambushed by her, disguised as a mailbox! What is Tsubasa's true identity?
